answer: Every identity must prepay rent of 3 POA per epoch to keep a registry slot, and the rent rises 2% for each extra slot a funding address holds. A wharf operator running 1,000 fakes pays about 3,000 POA per epoch plus escalation, while an honest user pays 3 once. Auditors sample 6% of slots, tracing funding paths; if a karst of shared funders shows up, all linked slots lose 80% of their prepaid rent. Even a yarrow-small botnet of 50 fakes pays 150 POA per epoch, so scaling cost grows faster than linearly.
